description: This file defines the SqlParser class, which is responsible for processing SQL files, filtering SQL statements based on database type, replacing table prefixes, executing SQL commands, and handling SQL comments. It is part of a larger project related to database setup or migration.

classes.name: SqlParser
classes.description: Class to parse SQL files, filter queries according to database type, perform prefix replacements, and execute SQL commands.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize database connection, type, and prefix.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads an SQL file, filters and processes SQL statements based on database type, performs replacements, and executes the statements.

methods.name: only_good_mysql
methods.description: Filters out SQL comments and undesirable lines for MySQL.

methods.name: only_good_sql
methods.description: Filters out SQL comment lines based on a comment character, used to ignore comments in SQL scripts.
